items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: Butch and I were like eight weeks in Germany a couple of years ago, on the bus doing one-nighters all through the country.

ctx.x: Well when you describe leaving that situation to go on the circuit, can you describe to me what circuit exists now for you?

Well I think there’s a handful of about 50 to 100 guys who are traveling around the world doing different jazz oriented things within the spectrum of the music that we’re listening to right now, doing these kind of jazz parties, festivals, here in the States and in Europe. And you might see my name on one or two of them and you’ll see somebody else’s name on two or three, but next year you might see that reversed. And so that’s basically what I’m talking about. Like I’ve done a festival or a party where I’m there…
and I were like eight weeks in Germany a couple of years ago, on the bus doing one- nighters all through the country.
